cases.name: etaf-desktop-settings-dismiss-restores-entry-focus
cases.purpose: Done and the installed Escape command restore focus to the Settings entry after editing Layout values, reopening the panel and resetting settings.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-settings-tabs-retain-controls-and-active-fields
cases.purpose: All four Settings tabs preserve focus and usable shell controls, publish their selected state, height, hint and only active controls, keep desktop geometry unchanged, and release controls on close.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-settings-reopen-retains-section-and-current-values
cases.purpose: Closing Settings removes its fields; reopening retains the selected tab with current controller values and working reset and close actions.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-demo-body-scroll-keeps-header-footer-live
cases.purpose: The public six-app demo keeps Notes header and footer controls fixed while its bounded body scrolls, resizes, returns to the top and accepts edits; closing cancels its mounted timers.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-locked-resize-confirms-controlled-geometry
cases.purpose: Configured resize gestures preserve the confirming position, focus and content.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-locked-resize-cancel-restores-controlled-geometry
cases.purpose: Escape restores the original rectangle for all resize handles.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-window-lifecycle-and-state-isolation
cases.purpose: Window operations preserve identity, raise order and immutable public snapshots.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-geometry-limits-maximize-minimize-restore
cases.purpose: Size limits and maximize/minimize/restore preserve a normal rectangle.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-floating-window-overflows-canvas-but-stays-reachable
cases.purpose: Floating windows cross the left, right and bottom canvas edges, are clipped and keep part of their title row reachable.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-minimize-and-workspace-removal-preserve-focus
cases.purpose: Minimizing or removing the active workspace selects a visible replacement window.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tiling-minimize-reflows-visible-leaves
cases.purpose: Minimized tiled members leave the layout tree and visible windows reclaim their space until restore.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-maximize-in-tiling-keeps-full-geometry
cases.purpose: Maximizing a tiled window keeps the full canvas rectangle while new leaves join the layout, then returns to tiling on restore.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-workspace-policy
cases.purpose: Workspace selection and removal preserve window ownership and reject invalid changes.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-mounted-window-and-taskbar
cases.purpose: A mounted window remains in the retained application tree while its body is hidden and returns through taskbar restore.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-bars-follow-focus-and-membership
cases.purpose: Window focus, minimization, taskbar activation and closing preserve bar selection, status and native targets.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-mounted-buffer-uses-configured-local-shortcuts
cases.purpose: Mounted Desktop buffers bind configured keys and key sequences, follow binding changes and reject printing-key prefixes and prefix conflicts.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-view-installs-shortcuts-in-named-target-buffer
cases.purpose: Mounting a Desktop View by target name installs local shortcuts in that target instead of the caller buffer.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-view-direct-mount-resolves-current-runtime-for-gestures
cases.purpose: A Playground-style direct View mount resolves the owning Runtime for title gestures and updates controlled geometry.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-close-preserves-caller-owned-runtime-and-buffer
cases.purpose: Closing a direct View preserves its caller-owned Runtime and buffer; a convenience mount releases only its own Runtime.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-body-activation-raises-window
cases.purpose: Pressing application content focuses and raises the corresponding desktop window.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-nested-content-activation-raises-window
cases.purpose: Pressing an interactive descendant bubbles to the window focus policy.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-native-title-drag-converts-pixels-to-rows
cases.purpose: A native title drag converts text-area pixel motion into one logical desktop row.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-native-drag-keeps-behavior-origin-across-rerenders
cases.purpose: A controlled title drag retains its origin while each motion publishes a new desktop generation.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-gesture-retains-origin-through-multiple-motions
cases.purpose: A mounted title gesture retains its origin through multiple move publications.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-gesture-repeated-sequences-reset-origin
cases.purpose: Repeated gestures begin from committed geometry after garbage collection.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-gesture-close-and-reopen-releases-retained-component
cases.purpose: Closing and reopening a window releases the old retained gesture component and starts cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-gesture-resizes-every-enabled-edge-and-corner
cases.purpose: Every enabled edge and corner publishes one controlled geometry update; body edges keep no handle.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-gesture-clamps-resize-at-desktop-origin
cases.purpose: A left resize gesture overflows the canvas and a top one stops at its origin, each preserving its opposite edge.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-gesture-divider-tracks-cumulative-displacement
cases.purpose: A tiling divider drag follows the pointer displacement from the press and a cancelled drag restores the start ratio.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-application-registry-and-lifecycle
cases.purpose: An application manifest launches, suspends, restores and closes an isolated instance through public callbacks.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-direct-window-close-syncs-app-lifecycle
cases.purpose: Directly closing owned windows updates application ownership, closes the final instance and focuses the remaining window.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-instance-status-follows-visible-focus
cases.purpose: Application status follows visible focus across minimization, empty workspaces, restoration and closing.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-launch-cleans-partial-window-creation
cases.purpose: A failed multi-window launch rolls back already-created windows before installing its isolated error placeholder.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-inactive-windows-show-gray-traffic-lights
cases.purpose: A desktop window renders gray macOS traffic lights unless it is the active window; focusing another window swaps the colored lights.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-confirm-close-asks-inside-the-desktop
cases.purpose: With confirm-close enabled, pressing a window's Close control opens an in-desktop dialog instead of a minibuffer prompt; Cancel keeps the window and Close window removes it.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-default-canvas-fills-the-render-window
cases.purpose: An unconfigured desktop sizes its shell from the window it renders into, so a Playground-style preview fills its window without overflowing it.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-canvas-follows-window-resize
cases.purpose: A default desktop refits its shell, tiles, maximized and floating windows on every workspace to the Emacs window's new size through etaf-desktop-fit-canvas.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-application-errors-are-isolated
cases.purpose: A failing application becomes an error placeholder while other desktop windows remain usable.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-session-roundtrip-restores-app-state
cases.purpose: A serializable desktop session invokes application restore callbacks and reapplies saved window geometry.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-session-roundtrip-restores-layout-policy
cases.purpose: Session restore preserves independent workspace layout modes, split topology and ratios.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-session-unknown-app-isolated
cases.purpose: A missing application during session restore becomes an error placeholder without aborting the desktop.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-toggle-layout-mode-switches-the-workspace
cases.purpose: The workspace layout control switches between floating and tiling, preserves the last rectangles when floating and returns other modes to tiling.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-settings-layout-select-follows-workspace-mode
cases.purpose: The settings Layout tab shows the active workspace's live layout mode after bar toggles, API changes and workspace switches, independent of the stored preference.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-mounted-workspace-switch-is-retained
cases.purpose: Switching workspaces on a mounted desktop, directly or by focusing another workspace's window, keeps the ETAF generation while hiding and showing the right windows, focusing the highest visible one, updating the layout label and listing every workspace's windows in the taskbar.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-mounted-layout-toggle-rerenders-both-directions
cases.purpose: The mounted Floating/Tiled control remains live and rerenders its label after both directions of a toggle.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-mode-switch-reveals-tiles-after-maximize
cases.purpose: The mounted layout control exits floating maximization and publishes both tiled window bodies.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-close-tiled-window-keeps-other-workspace-isolated
cases.purpose: Closing a tile and revisiting another workspace leaves only same-workspace content visible while an error placeholder remains isolated.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tiled-error-window-keeps-title-visible
cases.purpose: An error placeholder joining a tiled workspace keeps its title row outside the divider gap.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-shell-controls-and-live-tiling-refresh
cases.purpose: The mounted shell exposes launcher and switcher controls and applies tiling to a newly opened window.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-presses-outside-a-modal-dismiss-it
cases.purpose: Pressing a window control while the launcher, switcher or settings dialog is open closes it, and a taskbar press that opens another modal closes the current one in the same press.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-settings-modal-overlays-live-shell
cases.purpose: Settings persist as desktop state and open as a modal over the retained window surface.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tiling-layout-and-split-resize
cases.purpose: Tiling assigns non-overlapping rectangles and applies an adjustable split ratio.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tiling-two-workspaces-publishes-both-trees
cases.purpose: Two tiled workspaces publish their own divider nodes in one canvas without key collisions.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-divider-orientation-refreshes-rendered-input
cases.purpose: Changing an existing split between horizontal and vertical refreshes its visible accessible label, pointer, handle dimensions and subsequent controlled gesture.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-nested-splitters-occupy-reserved-gaps
cases.purpose: Nested divider handles center in custom inner gaps and drag changes only the selected subtree ratio.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-layout-floating-and-untile
cases.purpose: Untiling preserves a floating overlay and retile restores it to the tree.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-layout-vertical-split-moves-one-row-per-step
cases.purpose: Resizing a vertical split by consecutive one-row ratio steps on an odd span moves the first pane and the second pane's origin by exactly one row per step, so a divider drag follows the pointer without sticking and jumping.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-layout-horizontal-split-and-minimums
cases.purpose: Horizontal tiling respects minimum widths and preserves the split ratio.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-layout-monocle-and-close-sync
cases.purpose: Monocle fills the inset canvas and closing a window removes its layout leaf.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-layout-master-stack-reflows-new-windows
cases.purpose: Master-stack gives the first window a master region and reflows newly opened stack windows.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tile-spacing-defaults-and-reset
cases.purpose: New and reset settings use detached one-cell outer and inner gap preferences and inset tiled geometry.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tile-spacing-custom-gaps
cases.purpose: Zero and custom outer margins and nested inner gaps use character widths horizontally and text rows vertically, retaining the minimum horizontal divider width.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tile-spacing-reflows-active-workspace
cases.purpose: Spacing changes immediately reflow active tiles without changing topology, ratios, focus or floating rectangles.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tile-spacing-validates-without-mutation
cases.purpose: Spacing accepts all supported integers and rejects invalid types and bounds without changing settings, layout or geometry.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tile-spacing-outer-gaps-yield-to-minimums
cases.purpose: Outer margins shrink independently on both axes to preserve pane minimum sizes and inner gaps on a tight canvas.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tile-spacing-monocle-preserves-outer-gap
cases.purpose: Monocle preserves its outer margin whenever each overlaid pane fits, independently of the retained split tree's summed minimum sizes and inner gap.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tile-spacing-preserves-maximum-size
cases.purpose: Custom inner gaps keep constrained panes within maximum width or height while their neighbors fill the remaining canvas.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tile-spacing-small-canvas-keeps-panes-inside
cases.purpose: On a small canvas, nested panes remain positive, non-overlapping and in bounds as inner gaps shrink without changing saved preferences.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tile-spacing-applies-on-workspace-switch
cases.purpose: Gap changes leave inactive workspace geometry untouched until selection applies the current global gap preferences.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tile-spacing-keeps-maximized-window-full-size
cases.purpose: Changing tile gaps preserves full-canvas maximization and restoration returns the window to the current split geometry.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tile-spacing-settings-controls-reflow-live-tiles
cases.purpose: Mounted settings tabs change tile spacing immediately, retain values across tab switches, reset defaults and close through Done.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tile-spacing-session-roundtrip
cases.purpose: A saved session restores custom spacing, split topology and tiled and floating geometry over existing gap preferences.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tile-spacing-session-rejects-invalid-gaps
cases.purpose: Session restore rejects persisted gaps outside the public integer ranges.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-session-restores-fixed-floating-window
cases.purpose: A non-resizable, non-movable floating window restores its saved rectangle and flags without aborting the rest of the session.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-session-restores-floating-geometry-with-retained-tree
cases.purpose: A workspace switched from tiling to floating restores manually edited window geometry while preserving its retained split tree and spacing.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-session-retains-panes-smaller-than-minimums
cases.purpose: A saved small-canvas layout restores every pane and its minimum-size policy even when the allocated tile dimensions are below those minimums.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-geometry-queries-stay-reactive-and-atomic
cases.purpose: Public reactive snapshots observe complete floating geometry and focus mutations, and invalid coordinates leave the previous snapshot intact.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-mounted-geometry-survives-membership-and-settings
cases.purpose: Mounted window geometry remains live across membership and settings changes while nested input and detached prior snapshots retain their behavior.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-shortcuts-traverse-visible-windows-both-directions
cases.purpose: Repeated mounted next/previous shortcuts visit every visible same-workspace window independently of paint order.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-shortcuts-split-skips-hidden-windows
cases.purpose: The mounted split shortcut selects a visible same-workspace neighbor without restoring minimized windows.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-shortcuts-swap-tiled-leaves-retains-policy
cases.purpose: The mounted swap shortcut exchanges tiled leaves while retaining topology, ratios, focus and floating or minimized windows.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-shortcuts-swap-floating-visible-rectangles
cases.purpose: The mounted floating swap shortcut exchanges visible rectangles without changing minimized windows.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-master-stack-keeps-user-split-ratios
cases.purpose: Master-stack preserves resized horizontal and vertical splits across focus, refresh and workspace switches, and keeps its master ratio when adding a window.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-shortcuts-close-observes-confirmation
cases.purpose: The mounted close key opens the configured confirmation card, cancel keeps the window, and confirming closes it.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-dividers-drag-from-constrained-edges-on-both-axes
cases.purpose: Horizontal and vertical divider gestures start from the actual minimum/maximum-constrained edge and cancellation restores the accepted ratio.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-keyboard-cycling-focuses-the-activated-window
cases.purpose: The next-window shortcut raises a covered window and moves keyboard focus into it, so window move keys act on that window.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-keyboard-tab-activates-tiled-windows
cases.purpose: Tab traversal entering a tiled window activates it without a pointer press.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-keyboard-steps-tiling-divider
cases.purpose: A tiling divider reached with Tab moves its split ratio with the arrow keys.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-native-title-click-only-focuses
cases.purpose: A zero-displacement native title press/release focuses a normal or maximized window while preserving its coordinates, dimensions and mode.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-font-default-overrides-and-reset
cases.purpose: Desktop window typography defaults to Emacs inheritance, explicit title/body pixel sizes apply independently, and reset or nil restores inheritance.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-font-settings-restore-inheritance
cases.purpose: Appearance font controls display Emacs default and restore each existing explicit override independently or through Reset settings.
